\label{lemma-upper-shriek-derived}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a finite type separated morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
The functor
$Rf_! : D(X_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(Y_\etale, \Lambda)$
has a right adjoint
$Rf^! : D(Y_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(X_\etale, \Lambda)$.

has a right adjoint
$Rf^! : D(Y_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(X_\etale, \Lambda)$.
hypotheses:

and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
conclusions:

semantic_review_note: For separated finite-type f between qcqs schemes and torsion Λ, the derived compact-support Rf_! admits RIGHT adjoint Rf^!. The adjunction direction and unbounded derived categories are preserved.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-Rf-upper-shriek-for-quasi-finite}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated quasi-finite morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
The functor $Rf^! : D(Y_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(X_\etale, \Lambda)$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-upper-shriek-derived} is the same as the functor
$Rf^!$ of Lemma \ref{lemma-lqf-shriek-derived}.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a **separated quasi-finite** morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and $\Lambda$ a torsion ring. The right adjoint $Rf^!:D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)\to D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ of compactification-defined $Rf_!$ is canonically isomorphic to the derived right adjoint of the exact finite-support direct image $f_!$ constructed for locally quasi-finite morphisms.
hypotheses:
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated quasi-finite morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
conclusions: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a **separated quasi-finite** morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and $\Lambda$ a torsion ring. The right adjoint $Rf^!:D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)\to D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ of compactification-defined $Rf_!$ is canonically isomorphic to the derived right adjoint of the exact finite-support direct image $f_!$ constructed for locally quasi-finite morphisms.
semantic_review_note: For separated quasi-finite f of qcqs schemes with torsion Λ, the right adjoint Rf^! of compactification-defined Rf_! agrees with the right adjoint of finite-support exact f_!. Both origins and common domain are retained.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-Rf-upper-shriek-for-etale}
Let $j : U \to X$ be a separated \'etale morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
The functor $Rj^! : D(X_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(U_\etale, \Lambda)$
is equal to $j^{-1}$.
statement:
Let $j : U \to X$ be a separated \'etale morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
The functor $Rj^! : D(X_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(U_\etale, \Lambda)$
is equal to $j^{-1}$.
hypotheses:
Let $j : U \to X$ be a separated \'etale morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion coefficient ring.
conclusions:
The functor $Rj^! : D(X_\etale, \Lambda) \to D(U_\etale, \Lambda)$
is equal to $j^{-1}$.
semantic_review_note: For separated ÉTALE j between qcqs schemes with torsion Λ, exceptional inverse image Rj^! coincides with ordinary j^{-1}. Separation and torsion coefficient ring remain.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-iso-on-RSheafHom}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated finite type morphism of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring.
For every $K \in D(Y_\etale, \Lambda)$ and $L \in D(X_\etale, \Lambda)$
the map (\ref{equation-sheafy-trace})
$$
Rf_*R\SheafHom_\Lambda(L, Rf^!K) \longrightarrow R\SheafHom_\Lambda(Rf_!L, K)
$$
is an isomorphism.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring. For every $K\in D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ and $L\in D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$, the canonical morphism $$Rf_*R\mathcal{H}om_\Lambda(L,Rf^!K)\to R\mathcal{H}om_\Lambda(Rf_!L,K)$$ is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$. This morphism is formed by applying $Rf_*$ to internal Hom, then functoriality of $Rf_!$, and finally the counit of the adjunction $Rf_!Rf^!K\to K$.
hypotheses:
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated finite type morphism of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring.
conclusions: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring. For every $K\in D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ and $L\in D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$, the canonical morphism $$Rf_*R\mathcal{H}om_\Lambda(L,Rf^!K)\to R\mathcal{H}om_\Lambda(Rf_!L,K)$$ is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$. This morphism is formed by applying $Rf_*$ to internal Hom, then functoriality of $Rf_!$, and finally the counit of the adjunction $Rf_!Rf^!K\to K$.
semantic_review_note: For separated finite-type f between qcqs schemes, torsion Λ, L∈D(X) and K∈D(Y), the natural Rf_*RSheafHom(L,Rf^!K)→RSheafHom(Rf_!L,K) is an ISO. All derived functors and the adjunction counit direction are retained.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-iso-global-hom}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated finite type morphism of
quasi-separated and quasi-compact schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring.
For every $K \in D(Y_\etale, \Lambda)$ and $L \in D(X_\etale, \Lambda)$ the map
(\ref{equation-sheafy-trace}) induces an isomorphism
$$
R\Hom_X(L, Rf^!K) \longrightarrow R\Hom_Y(Rf_!L, K)
$$
of global derived homs.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated finite type between quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring. For $L\in D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$, the morphism induced by the internal-Hom comparison and the adjunction counit $$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(L,Rf^!K)\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_!L,K)$$ is an isomorphism of derived global Hom complexes.
hypotheses:
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a separated finite type morphism of
quasi-separated and quasi-compact schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring.
conclusions: Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated finite type between quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and let $\Lambda$ be a torsion ring. For $L\in D(X_{\acute et},\Lambda)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\acute et},\Lambda)$, the morphism induced by the internal-Hom comparison and the adjunction counit $$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(L,Rf^!K)\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_!L,K)$$ is an isomorphism of derived global Hom complexes.
semantic_review_note: Under same separated finite-type qcqs torsion coefficients, derived global Hom RHom_X(L,Rf^!K)→RHom_Y(Rf_!L,K) is an isomorphism, not merely an H^0 adjunction. Both derived complexes remain.
